title: PELS at Khanvil Resort
summary: BODH, President Elect Learning Session held at Khanvel Resort, Silvassa has seen multifold activities.
description:
BODH, President Elect Learning Session held at Khanvel Resort, Silvassa has seen multifold activities. Apart from great learning and good grounding of next year's leaders there was a lot of fun and frolic keeping in spirirt of fellowship of Rotary. Celebration of Karva chauth was a scintillating experience. Ladies in traditional festive attires were the glittering starts. There was a bollywood retro when members showed their talents.
Most redeeming part of the news is PE Rtn. Chetna Mehta won 1st Prize for Best Female Dress-Up at Karwa Cahuth Event.
PE Rtn.Chetna Mehta and Rtn.Hitesh Mehta stood out winning 1st Prize for Best Couple Dress-Up at the Bollywood Retro Night.
It was a DOUBLE DHAMAKA for our esteemed club. We excel in service and we excel in fellowship too.
